rationale_chunks_concat_exact: Reviewed all ten IDs against both other seed versions, including every supplied title, complete description, keyword, distribution title/description/format, publisher and optional spatial field; no temporal fields were supplied. Measurement concepts and units are preserved per ID: a001/a002 insect count, treatment and rate; a003 count/treatment only; a004 count only; a005 operational month/site/count only; a006/a007 mass/area/season; a008 mass/area only; a009 mass only; a010 mass/area/season in PDF only. Unlisted treatment rates, seasons and areas are not inferred. All CSV descriptions identify comma-separated tables, JSON descriptions identi

fy JSON records with the same columns, and both PDF distributions of a010 identify PDF tables; no metadata format/content conflict was found. Verification is of supplied metadata association, not fetched file bytes. The forbidden positive tokens arthropod/suppression and orchard/productivity are absent from the corresponding supplied records. No frozen no-answer conjunction or explicit answer-key/intent/grade leakage appears. All identity_review_required flags are false; identity values are null because no authoritative identity audit is assigned here. Same-intent pairs a001/a002 and a006/a007 have distinct titles, locations and numeric examp

les rather than identical complete records. Wording varies beyond title substitution: a001's description directly lists measurements here, whereas 39032/39033 place them only in distributions; a002 and a004 are much longer here, while a003 and a006 expand in other seeds. Nevertheless strict factual preservation is not established: a001 distributions.0.description says insects counted per inspected tree (count; e.g. 14) and treatment application volume (litres/hectare; e.g. 3.28), versus count 10/rate 10.03 in 39032 and count 26/rate 6.48 in 39033. Its description location changes from Silver Creek Central to Oak Terrace Upper to Quartz Field

Lower. Numeric examples change in every ID across seeds, and publisher/location context changes too. These are substantive text facts, not mere paraphrases, even though measurement concepts remain stable. a005's unresolved crop-tree versus warehouse-bag material ambiguity also persists across all three versions. No query text is supplied, so actual paraphrase equivalence and exact-lookup query semantics cannot be independently assessed from intent identifiers alone; corpus-wide coverage outside these ten IDs is not claimed. Formulaic catalogue-style titles recur; none supplies an authoritative SKU, hidden label or different measured fact. If
strict policy treats these recurrent prose shells as template-only titles, that style boundary needs adjudication rather than an inferred acceptance.

ist into a longer description here, a006 expanding with units and reuse notes, and a007 becoming a short distribution-directed synopsis. from 10.81 to 7.28 to 7.53 litres/hectare. Every ID changes at least one numeric example, and locations/publishers are not invariant. That ambiguity is not resolved by lexical similarity. ied s01p/s02p IDs contain no actual query strings, so paraphrase semantic equivalence cannot be verified; this packet also cannot establish global positive/exact coverage. e 8/19/18 and a004 counts are 8/14/26. Together with the a001/a002/a005/a006/a007 comparisons documented in the other seed rationales, all ten IDs have changed numeric examples.
